title: Sherman on affecting the sine wave at will

tellings.quote: >> I could definitely affect the the motion and I could do it just at will.

plain: In the 1990s, at a complex of the National Security Agency in Maryland (the agency that runs US electronic spying), a man named Dan Sherman says he could change the movement of a sine wave, a smooth repeating line on a signal display, using only his mind. Sherman, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, tells Michels this from his own experience: "I could definitely affect the motion and I could do it just at will." If true, it would mean a person's mind could act directly on a signal.
